record.question: Which of the following phenomenon is an important self-preserving property of syrups for protection against microbial contaminations?
record.explanation: Answer C: Dehydration. Concentrated syrups resist microbial growth partly because high sugar concentration lowers water activity by osmosis/dehydration. Reference: https://www.fda.gov/food/food-ingredients-packaging/ water-activity-aw-foods. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
